vo: If you want five AI bots running your business while you sleep,
this is the only guide you need.
I run an online store and a small agency on one team of Grok Bots,
and that team checks its own work.
By the end, you'll know why separate AI helpers fail,
how to give each Bot one clear job,
the exact message to send each one,
how to put them on a schedule,
so the work is done before you wake up.
And it's way easier than it sounds.
It feels like a real team in one group chat.
They hand work to each other,
and they even catch each other's mistakes.
